# Mecklenburg County Housing & Homelessness Dashboard

> A comprehensive data platform tracking housing instability, homelessness services, and coordinated entry systems in Mecklenburg County.

Mecklenburg Housing Data provides access to HUD Coordinated Entry System data, research reports on housing stability and child welfare outcomes, and dashboards analyzing homelessness prevention and housing assistance programs across Mecklenburg County. The platform is developed in partnership with UNC Charlotte Urban Institute, Mecklenburg County Community Support Services, and local housing advisory boards.

## Key Topics

- Mecklenburg County
- Coordinated Entry System
- HUD (Housing and Urban Development)
- Homelessness Data
- Housing Instability
- Housing Stability
- Child Welfare Outcomes
- Homeless Services
- Housing Assistance
- Prevention Data
- Data Dashboard
- Family Separation Prevention
- UNC Charlotte Urban Institute
- Mecklenburg County Community Support Services

- [Coordinated Entry Data: Landing Page](https://mecklenburghousingdata.org/coordinated-entry-data-landing-page): Landing page for HUD Coordinated Entry System data in Mecklenburg County

- [Research Hub](https://mecklenburghousingdata.org/research): Research hub featuring housing instability reports and data dashboards
- [Keeping Families Together: Housing Stability and Child Welfare Outcomes](https://mecklenburghousingdata.org/frontpage-article/keeping-families-together-what-the-evaluation-shows-about-housing-stability-and-child-welfare-outcomes): Program evaluation article on housing stability and child welfare outcomes
